# The wasm stride default never applies off wasm: the default
# arm64 build carries no logosloopstride flag.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOARCH=arm64

cd m
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'logosloopstride'
env GOARCH=

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/preemptbackedgearm64

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func spin(n int) int {
	s := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s += i
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	println(spin(100))
}
